title: Fecal MicrobiotaTransplant for the Treatment of Parkinson's Disease
official: An Open-Label Phase I Clinical Trial of Vancomycin Followed by Fecal Microbiota Transplant for the Treatment of Parkinson's Disease
summary: FMT may significantly improve quality of life and Parkinson Disease (PD) symptom severity measurements. We hypothesize that gut microbial dysbiosis is a major contributing factor in Parkinson's disease.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Individuals diagnosed with PD

Exclusion Criteria:

* Non-PD individuals
